subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' (a) Students cut a i. our mother tongue (b) It is difficult ii. are highly interested. (c) Students cram the answers iii. at home in English. (d) The English Text Books are not up iv. to the standard of the students. (e) Students do not feel v. to pass the exam. vi. sorry figure in English. vii. to master of foreign language.
guide_solution: (a) Students cut a sorry figure in English. (b) It is difficult to master of foreign language. (c) Students cram the answers to pass the exam. (d) The English Text Books are not up to the standard of the students. (e) Students do not feel at home in English.
